description: How an opened past or remote session's transcript is drawn, where it differs from a live chat: drawn from the transcript file in chunks, newest first, with a Show earlier messages button at the top; things only a transcript has (CI events, artifact records, summaries) get their own looks.
opens: Clicking a session in the sidebar

parts.name: Show earlier messages
parts.shows: A button centred at the top of the chat while earlier parts aren't drawn: "Show earlier messages (N more)" (or without the count). Earlier chunks (60 items each) also draw by themselves as you scroll near them; the chat is about its full height from the start so the scrollbar doesn't jump.

actions.does: Draws the topmost chunk not drawn yet, keeping the view where it is.

parts.name: your messages
parts.shows: As live (UserTurn), images and PDFs attached shown as attachments; injected text (system reminders, local-command output, caveats, task notifications) is never shown as a message. A message the host's sender store says is someone else's is a SenderTurn. The session's first prompt, if it came from outside, is a StartPrompt.

parts.name: replies and calls
parts.shows: As live. Calls whose result never came are shown interrupted (no spinner for ever); background tasks never heard to end are settled as interrupted too. A turn that was stopped gets one "interrupted" note.

parts.name: CI event
parts.shows: A pull-request event the desktop app reported: a small dimmed disclosure titled with what happened (first words of its message, or "A CI event"), folded; opened, its text as markdown.

parts.name: artifact record
parts.shows: Claude Desktop's record of an artifact it published: a small dimmed "Published <title> ↗" line (see Artifact).

parts.name: task notification
parts.shows: Its card (if drawn) ends; otherwise the quiet ending line (see BackgroundTask).

parts.name: compaction
parts.shows: A CompactMark with its summary folded under it.

states.name: opened, not yet written to
states.shows: No banner and no resumed mark; "— resumed —" appears above your message once you write.

states.name: active elsewhere (tail)
states.shows: New messages appear as they're written, with spinners on running calls; the composer is replaced (see Composer/Banners).

states.name: cut short by a restart
states.shows: The CutShort line at the end.
